capturePath.persistenceOrder: Shadow archive save attempted first; external evidence collection/persistence attempted separately afterward.

failureModes.witness: Shadow persistence can fail/partially write while evidence collection still uses the complete in-memory archive and evidence persistence may succeed, or vice versa.
failureModes.consequence: Evidence rows and durable parent rows can have different keysets for the same scan_date.

failureModes.witness: Both parent and evidence tables are mutable by (scan_date,symbol); rerun can overwrite each independently without parent snapshot hash/generation.
failureModes.consequence: A later evidence row can appear joined to the same date/symbol even if the underlying parent cohort/snapshot generation changed.

failureModes.parentReader: ORDER BY scan_date ASC, cohort ASC, cohort_rank ASC LIMIT 5000
failureModes.evidenceReader: ORDER BY scan_date ASC, symbol ASC LIMIT 5000
failureModes.witness: When 5000 cuts through a scanDate, different secondary sort orders can retain different symbol subsets on that boundary date.
failureModes.consequence: Returned parents and returned evidence can disagree even when both tables were originally one-to-one.

currentMissingHandling.good: Missing evidence becomes null rather than false/bad.
currentMissingHandling.remainingProblem: Null does not distinguish no capture, partial write, rerun lineage mismatch, reader truncation, parse failure or provider unavailability.

requiredRepair: Every external-evidence receipt references immutable parentDecisionReceiptId or parentSnapshotHash plus captureGeneration.
Parent and evidence readers use one complete parent keyset; evidence is fetched/joined by that exact keyset, not an independently truncated date-range query.
Persist expectedEvidenceParentCount and actualEvidenceReceiptCount by generation/date.
Same parent + same evidence fingerprint is idempotent; same identity + different evidence fingerprint must create a new version/receipt or provenance conflict, not overwrite first-known.
Expose missingJoinReason: NOT_CAPTURED / PARTIAL_WRITE / PARENT_GENERATION_MISMATCH / READER_TRUNCATED / PARSE_ERROR / PROVIDER_UNKNOWN.
Promotion-grade evidence requires complete parent-generation alignment; otherwise external context is UNKNOWN.
